name: Nullharbor
notes: High-mode flight hitching on the Fold is a hot-path bug, not a huge-canvas bug: Gabe sees the same stutter on the outer cover (tiny) and the inner display. High still painted 340 live stars, a live galaxy band (gradients + dust), every planet orbit as a giant stroked circle, and allocated lighting gradients per craft per frame — work that does not shrink on a small screen.

High (and Balanced) keep silhouette AA, capsule station spokes, extrusion, and corona. The frame is cheaper because dim stars and the Milky Way blit from caches, far orbit/scoop rings are culled, and hull lighting gradients are reused. Performance LOD stays an extra option. Single sky fill, bake-before-fill, and transparent synchronized #space are unchanged.

Verify Full/High on the Fold outer cover and again on the inner display — both must cruise without hitch. A cover hitch means the hot path is still too expensive; do not treat this as a pixel-budget-only check.
Service worker cache bumped to farbound-v2.16.4. Save keys stay farbound-save-v2.
